files.name: CHANGELOG.md
files.body:
Deprecation cleanup.

- `Notifier::prepare()` now throws `\OCP\Notification\UnknownNotificationException` instead of `\InvalidArgumentException` when a notification isn't ours (or is a reminder for an unknown SuiteCRM module). Since Nextcloud 30, `\InvalidArgumentException` is the deprecated contract and every `/ocs/v2.php/apps/notifications` poll emitted a level-2 warning naming this notifier; the new class is the NC-30+ replacement. Behaviour is identical (row still suppressed on unknown subject); the warning line stops.
